# New Beansland

Official public site: https://newbeansland.org/
Founder: Jamel Hawkins
Contact: founder@newbeansland.org

New Beansland is a connected creative world. Public rooms include Books, University, Clothing, NBL Kids, TV & Film, Timmy V Studios, Founder’s Office, and About.

Current public facts:
- NBL Clothing Co. is open. Current public clothing and current footwear are available by request. The Not So Small™ line and NBL Pride Collection are Coming Soon.
- NBL Kids is an open New Beansland department led and designed by Shanique Washington. Current NBL Kids statement shirts are available; Not So Small™ remains Coming Soon.
- New Beansland University Foundation Program enrollment is open. The public University page is the enrollment door; course materials, instructions, coursework, and grading are delivered after enrollment rather than presented as a public web classroom.
- The City is Coming Soon. Its official trailer and soundtrack preview are public now.
- Timmy V Studios is open. It is the named New Beansland studio within NBL Studios and NBL Records; the name does not imply a separate public backstory.
- Beans is the conversational intelligence for NBL Chat. Beans is AI. Founder approval is required for canon, publishing, spending, and policy.
- Do not invent New Beansland rooms, staff, products, prices, or history.
- Do not treat private development, Replit previews, or Playhouse notes as public canon.

Retrieve public pages on newbeansland.org before answering as if a door is open.
